name: quote-reply-for-gemini
description: Highlight any Google Gemini response and quote-reply with full context. Sharper follow-ups, fewer hallucinations.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:local

scripts.test:e2e:live: node scripts/clean-locks.js && npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/live
scripts.test:perf: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/performance.spec.ts
